nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: Management did not give specific quarterly guidance for Q2 FY27. In November 2025, management projected FY26 revenue around ₹12,500 crore with about 5% growth the coming year (FY27), average margins around 15% plus, or 12% to 15% for new projects. Q2 FY27's reported 16.5% revenue decline and 8.1% EBITDA margin fall well below these annual ranges.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
If it is some newer vessels, it may not necessarily be that high. But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
But that will not be the case for the new projects coming in, where we are booking the actual value of production. And in that case, we expect that the margins will be around 12% to 15%

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: Management did not discuss any distrust of intermediate CAs, root CA distrust, or key generation flaws. The closest discussion occurred in the Q4 FY26 call, where management stated that a Google policy change regarding multi-purpose and new root certificates had no impact because existing roots remained trusted while new roots were queued.

evidence.quote: Our new roots have been submitted some time back

So, nothing stops for us because our existing roots are already trusted on Google and we basically have a transition period where the existing roots will continue to work until the new roots are accepted by Google
So, there is really no impact as such

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106818788.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818788.answer: Management did not give specific quantitative guidance for revenue and margins for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, though they stated an aspirational EBIT margin goal of 16% to 17% during the Q2 FY27 call.

evidence.quote: so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: Management stated in August 2026 that Q1 FY27 gaming revenue reached 275 crores with a 19.5% EBITDA margin, and expects overall platform acceleration in FY27. Reported Q2 FY27 revenue of 803.1 crore and an EBITDA margin of 14.1% reflect strong top-line growth exceeding previous quarterly bases, though margins shifted with increased user acquisition investments.

evidence.quote: Our gaming revenue increased 14% year-on-year to INR 275 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 19.5% and all our gaming businesses remained EBITDA positive while showing positive growth
EBITDA held flat as UA spend rose from 78% to 85% of revenue, though revenue net of UA spend still increased from INR 73 crores to INR 80 crores

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management stated in October 2026 that food delivery margins are expected to remain flattish over the next 1 or 2 years as they reinvest in growth, and quick commerce growth will pick up starting the December quarter. The reported Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹24,138.0 crore (+77.6% YoY) with an EBITDA margin of 3.1% compared to 1.8% a year ago.

evidence.quote: Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish
What we are saying here is that as we accelerate store addition, which is starting OND, we don't expect that to hit the margins in the short term

nse:106810133.question: What has management said about debt, leverage and its credit profile?
nse:106810133.answer: Management stated that the company's core infrastructure profile tracks within a net external debt of approximately INR 45,000 crores, supported by a regulatory asset base of under $4 billion. For metals, materials, and mining, net external debt is about $2 billion against $6 billion of operating assets. Management guides to a leverage range of 3.5x to 4.5x for core infrastructure and a conservative profile for mining, with overall leverage expected to remain flat or slightly down from 3.9x.

evidence.quote: for example, in core infra, which is platform, we have a net external debt of, say, INR45,000 crores, which is about just under $5 billion. Against that, the regulatory asset base itself is just under $4 billion.
the metals, materials and mining, we have a net external debt of about $2 billion, against where we call our operating assets, which are roughly around about $6 billion.

our core infra will track the core infra. So we guide to that in the core infra while we are growing, we will be closer to the 3.5 to 4.5 range. And obviously, we'll be lower in relation to the mining.

nse:106805308.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106805308.answer: Management announced that the RBI approved Mr. Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and CEO for three years effective October 27, 2026, replacing Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan. Additionally, Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan stated on the Q2 FY27 call in October 2026 that he is leaving behind an organization led by a new leader, and Mr. Bagchi expressed gratitude to the Board for his appointment.

evidence.quote: I'll also leave behind in the hands of an able team spread across various levels in the organization throughout the country, led by a new and an able leader, and I welcome Anup at this juncture heartily to the institution as well
Anup Bagchi: Thank you. Thank you, Sashi. Thank you, Srini. Thank you, Kaizad. I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO

nse:106819733.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106819733.answer: Management stated in October 2026 that Persistent Systems plans to raise USD 1.25 billion through a mix of debt and equity, including USD 450 million via equity, QIP, or equity-linked instruments like FCCBs. This long-term financing replaces an 18-month Euro 1.4 billion bridge loan intended to fund the acquisition of Nagarro.

evidence.quote: In terms of financing, we intend replacing the Euro 1.4 billion 18-month bridge loan with longer tenure, capital and favorable terms
As a part of this long-term financing strategy, we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity
Out of this, USD 450 million will be raised through equity, qualified institutional placement or equity-linked instruments like FCCB or combination of similar instruments

nse:106831929.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106831929.answer: Management had stated that post stabilization, the Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway assets were expected to add well over ₹3,000 crores to EBITDA. For Q2 FY27, Adani Enterprises reported revenue of ₹37,215.6 crore (a 75.1% YoY increase) and an EBITDA margin of 14.8% compared to 15.6% a year ago.

evidence.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL
Post stabilization, these 3 assets are expected to add well over INR3,000 crores to EBITDA

nse:106830187.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830187.answer: Management did not discuss revenue and margin forecasts for Q2 FY27 during the Q4 FY26 earnings call, as that call occurred in April 2026 prior to the period. However, for FY27, management expected Maruti's volume growth to be over 10%, supported by new capacity additions.

evidence.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year

nse:106829216.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829216.answer: Management stated on the Q1 FY27 call in July 2026 that they expect to increase profitability further in subsequent quarters and achieve higher EBITDA margins in the long term, noting a near-term target of 15% to 20% within two to three years. This result matches the stated expectations, as Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹2,648.0 crore (+28.5% YoY), EBITDA rose to ₹270.0 crore (+91.5% YoY), and the EBITDA margin expanded to 10.2% compared to 6.8% a year ago.

evidence.quote: Going forward, as you would have seen that we have had a profitability increase I would believe that I think we should be able to increase our profitability further in consequent quarters right away onwards and then obviously the revenue growth will mean larger profit

Which is that we should be able to get to we have higher confidence of getting to that number and perhaps getting to it sooner and we do think that AI structurally not only accelerates operating leverage, it also expands the opportunity for higher margins over time
